public.guideLead: This installation is not accepting requests yet. Once access opens, connect your application in four steps.
public.step.model.body: In Models, check that the protocol matches your client. Copy the model ID and review the input, output and cache rates.
public.step.key.body: Sign in, open Keys and create a key for your application. Keep the secret on your server, not in browser code.
public.step.client.body: Use the base URL from Keys, your Relay key and the exact model ID. Send a short request using the protocol you chose.
public.step.usage.body: Open Usage and find the request by ID. Check its token counts and final charge; a pending amount is not a debit.

faq.what.question: What is Relay?
faq.what.answer: Relay lets you use AI models in your apps. You can find available models and prices in the dashboard.
faq.chat.question: Can I chat with an AI here?
faq.chat.answer: Use an API-compatible app to chat with AI models through Relay.
faq.price.question: How much does it cost?
faq.price.answer: The cost depends on the model and how much you use it. Check Models for pricing and Usage for the cost of each request.
faq.start.question: How do I get started?
faq.start.answer: Open the dashboard, create an API key and use it in your API-compatible app.
